en: The image is a sepia-toned, multi-view postcard featuring several landmarks and buildings. The central image shows three women walking among ancient stone ruins, framed by a large arched opening. Surrounding this are smaller images of grand civic or institutional buildings, more stone ruins, a street scene with a square and what appears to be a fountain or monument, and a large building on a river bend. The text at the bottom reads 'Üdvözlet Pécsről,' which is Hungarian.
